title: NFL Week 8 Preview: Ravens-Bills, Chiefs-Broncos and More
transcript_summary: Warren Sharp and Rich Hribar analyze key Week 8 NFL matchups, evaluating offensive metrics, defensive schemes, and personnel splits for Bills-Ravens, Lions-Vikings, Broncos-Chiefs, and Falcons-Buccaneers. They also highlight sneaky matchup angles for Bears-Seahawks on Monday Night Football and Patriots-Dolphins.

speaker_segments.speaker: Warren Sharp
speaker_segments.text: Welcome to Sharp Football Analysis. I'm Warren Sharp and this is the Week 8 Matchup Show.

speaker_segments.speaker: Warren Sharp
speaker_segments.text: Intro bumper for Sharp Football Analysis.

speaker_segments.speaker: Warren Sharp
speaker_segments.text: Warren welcomes Rich Hribar and breaks down Matchup 1: Bills offense vs. Ravens defense, detailing Baltimore's easy schedule facing passing offenses and their vulnerabilities against explosive pass attacks.

speaker_segments.speaker: Rich Hribar
speaker_segments.text: Rich analyzes Josh Allen's downfield efficiency splits with DJ Moore on the field versus off the field and how Moore's return unlocks explosive plays.

speaker_segments.speaker: Warren Sharp
speaker_segments.text: Warren reviews Buffalo's #1 ranked EPA per play, yards per attempt, and series conversion metrics across the league.

speaker_segments.speaker: Rich Hribar
speaker_segments.text: Rich notes Baltimore's past struggles against top passing offenses like Dak Prescott and Joe Burrow.

speaker_segments.speaker: Warren Sharp
speaker_segments.text: Warren highlights Baltimore's severe second-half drop-off across EPA per play, point differential, and third-down conversion rates.

speaker_segments.speaker: Rich Hribar
speaker_segments.text: Rich discusses Lamar Jackson's efficiency upon returning, Derrick Henry's low yards before contact, and Zay Flowers' elite slot production metrics.

speaker_segments.speaker: Warren Sharp
speaker_segments.text: Warren summarizes the Ravens' need to stay aggressive with Lamar Jackson rather than taking their foot off the gas in the second half.

speaker_segments.text: Warren introduces Matchup 2: Jared Goff vs. Brian Flores' Minnesota blitz and two-high defense.

speaker_segments.speaker: Rich Hribar

speaker_segments.speaker: Warren Sharp
speaker_segments.text: Warren provides historical context showing Minnesota's blitz/pressure rates are the highest since at least 2000, while evaluating Minnesota's recent QB schedule.

speaker_segments.speaker: Rich Hribar
speaker_segments.text: Rich details Jahmyr Gibbs' high pass protection rate vs. Minnesota's fronts and how it limits his availability in the receiving game.

speaker_segments.speaker: Warren Sharp

speaker_segments.speaker: Rich Hribar

speaker_segments.speaker: Warren Sharp
speaker_segments.text: Warren and Rich analyze Kenneth Walker's workload, Patrick Mahomes' low air-yards per completion vs. Denver, and the impact of DE Zach Allen's presence on Denver's run defense.

analysis_notes.topic: Ravens Pass Defense Strength of Schedule
analysis_notes.summary: Baltimore's pass defense has faced the 3rd easiest schedule of passing offenses in the NFL through Week 7, struggling severely whenever facing top-15 pass efficiency offenses like Dallas and Cincinnati.
analysis_notes.speaker: Warren Sharp
analysis_notes.quote: The Ravens defense hasn't played a very difficult schedule... they allowed massive production to any offense they faced with a heartbeat.

analysis_notes.topic: Josh Allen Downfield Efficiency with DJ Moore
analysis_notes.summary: Josh Allen is 19-of-29 (66% completion rate, 2nd in NFL) on throws of 10+ yards downfield when DJ Moore is on the field, averaging 9.6 yards per attempt compared to 8.3 YPA without him.
analysis_notes.speaker: Rich Hribar
analysis_notes.quote: Getting DJ Moore back and having that wide receiver one is what this offense is built around.

analysis_notes.summary: In the first half, Baltimore ranks #1 in point margin (+65) and EPA per play (+0.11). In the second half, they drop to #32 in point margin (-70) and #29 in EPA per play (-0.12).
analysis_notes.speaker: Warren Sharp
analysis_notes.quote: The Ravens second half drop off has been massive in these games.

analysis_notes.summary: Brian Flores' Minnesota defense is blitzing and generating pressure at historical ceiling rates not seen since at least 2000, presenting a unique challenge despite Goff's strong EPA against standard blitzes.
analysis_notes.speaker: Warren Sharp
analysis_notes.quote: The Minnesota Vikings are still way up there in the top right in terms of the highest blitz rate in the NFL by far.

analysis_notes.topic: Jahmyr Gibbs Pass Protection Rate vs Minnesota
analysis_notes.summary: Due to Minnesota's heavy blitz fronts, running backs pass-block 21% more often against the Vikings than any other team. Jahmyr Gibbs stayed in pass pro on 47% and 48% of pass snaps in last year's two meetings, holding him to just 5 catches for 28 yards total.
analysis_notes.speaker: Rich Hribar
analysis_notes.quote: Running backs have blocked at a 21% higher rate against the Vikings than they do normally in any other game.

analysis_notes.summary: When throwing 5+ yards downfield against Arizona, Bo Nix went 4-of-13 (31% completion rate), with 39% of his incompletions attributed to unforced quarterback inaccuracy.
analysis_notes.speaker: Warren Sharp
analysis_notes.quote: Bo Nix on throws 5+ yards downfield vs Arizona was 4 of 13... 39% of incompletions due to inaccuracy.

analysis_notes.topic: Tampa Bay Defense vs 11 vs 12 Personnel
analysis_notes.summary: Tampa Bay's defense ranks #1 in EPA/play against 11 personnel (-0.26) but drops to #26 against 12 personnel (+0.11). Atlanta used 12+ personnel on 65% of snaps last week.
analysis_notes.speaker: Warren Sharp
analysis_notes.quote: Versus 11 personnel defensively, Buccaneers are #1 in EPA per play... versus 12 personnel they drop all the way to #26.

analysis_notes.topic: Dolphins Defense vs Tight End Targets
analysis_notes.summary: Miami's defense has allowed 44 completions on 48 targets (91.7% completion rate) to opposing tight ends this season.
analysis_notes.speaker: Warren Sharp
analysis_notes.quote: Tight end targets against the Miami Dolphins have been completed on 44 out of 48 attempts.
